_README: Executions whose results were superseded or that were aborted: real, billed project spend that belongs to NO configuration's cost (PI ruling D22, 2026-10-03: excluded from per-run and per-configuration costs, counted in the project total). The register never prices these; the project-total reconciliation (plan WP6) adds them. Figures are on the audited basis (scripts/lib_cost.price_usage over the meta's own usage); null where the execution left no meta. Append as more are found; never delete an entry.
